# OSTEOMYELITIS

Obtain material for gram-stain and culture before initiating antimicrobials.

Blood and bone cultures are ideal.

Antibiotics should be held if patient does not have adjacent skin/soft tissue

infection

Duration of treatment and route will vary with differences in location of

infection, infecting organism, and host comorbidities.
